manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the medium-sized rectangular microwave with textured top's handle and pull to open it.

Task description: The target is the white rectangular microwave in the image. Grasp its door handle and pull the door outward.

Success criteria: The oven door opens outward by at least 60% of its maximum opening range. Pulling it open only a small crack does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the middle of the vertical handle on the right edge of the oven door, to the left of the two round knobs. Avoid the upper and lower joints, leaving enough room for pad contact.
- Match the gripper opening to the handle width and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm that the fingers enclose the handle from opposite sides; avoid only pressing its front or contacting the door panel and knob on the right.
- During pulling, adjust gripper position and orientation along the oven door's hinge arc rather than pulling continuously in a straight line and risking slip or jamming. Watch clearance from the pink alarm clock on the left as the door swings.
